title: Photo-Worthy Days Out: Places Teens Will Want to Post
description: Photo-worthy family days out teens will want to share: viaducts, castles, light trails, gardens and coastlines, plus tips for great photos without the queues.
h1: Photo-worthy days out teens will want to post
intro: Want a teenager who’s keen to come along? Pick somewhere that looks amazing on camera. Here are photo-worthy days out, many of them free.

image.alt: A steam train crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct in the Scottish Highlands

cardText: Viaducts, castles, light trails and coastlines made for photos.

blocks.title: Scout’s photo tip
blocks.text: Go early or at golden hour (just after sunrise or before sunset). The light is softer and the crowds are smaller.
points: Don’t stray off paths for a shot

sections.html:
• The Glenfinnan Viaduct when the Jacobite steams across.
  • The Giant’s Causeway’s hexagon columns.
  • The Jurassic Coast and other dramatic coastlines.

• Fairy-tale castles, from Edinburgh to Neuschwanstein.
  • Christmas light trails.
  • Kew’s glasshouses and treetop walkway.
No photo is worth a risk. Keep behind barriers, stay away from cliff edges and railway lines, and keep an eye on tides.

faqs.q: What is the best time of day for photos?
faqs.a: Golden hour, just after sunrise or before sunset, gives soft, warm light and often fewer crowds.
